gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noto-sans-nko: Noto Sans NKo reads modern and see-through, its rounded openings letting each word breathe without any fuss. Cherry Swash sits above it with a horseshoe c and heavy diagonals.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noto-sans-nko-unj: Noto Sans NKo Unjoined reads friendly and plain, with small letters opened wide. Cherry Swash above it keeps one stroke width from stem to connector, so the body text can stay a touch smaller than you'd expect.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noto-sans-old-sou: Cherry Swash draws every stem, bowl and tail like a length of rope, with a horseshoe c at its center. Noto Sans Old South Arabian is the quieter sans-serif, built for gentle curves.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-noto-sans-shavian: Noto Sans Shavian reads clean and loose, its curves running free and never knotting at the ends. Cherry Swash then adds a single constant stroke width, giving the pair a rope-like steadiness.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-ojuju: Ojuju reads like lightly flexed spring wire, with wide s curves barely curled in and a soft ebb in its strokes. But Cherry Swash holds a drawn-wire thickness throughout, so it carries the loud work.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-overpass: Cherry Swash brings a horseshoe c and diagonals as heavy as its verticals, a heading with real presence. Overpass follows in a modern sans whose strokes never swing between bold and light.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-palanquin: A horseshoe-shaped c gives Cherry Swash away at once. Palanquin carries a longer stretch of text easily, its curved letters keeping wide, unclosed mouths that let the eye glide along each line.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-philosopher: Cherry Swash keeps its horizontals as thick as its verticals, with a wide horseshoe c that stands out. Philosopher's sans-serif curves, full of daylight, would move gently down a longer passage.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-pontano-sans: Pontano Sans offers a contemporary body with wide open c terminals, tidy and easy on the eye. And Cherry Swash, with round letters as heavy as its straight ones, supplies the sturdy character.
gen-gf-cherry-swash-gf-pt-sans: Tubular, wire-like letterforms mark Cherry Swash, with a horseshoe c wide open. And PT Sans, with its open arcs, would carry a longer passage in an approachable, steady way.
